description: What are homes advertised for in Luxembourg? Paid ($0.02 USDC): mean ASKING prices (advertised by sellers, not sale prices) and EUR/m2 for apartments and houses for sale, national, by commune and Luxembourg-Ville quartier, latest 12 months (Observatoire de l'Habitat, CC0). Sale only. Information, not legal advice. This server holds no wallet and never pays: it returns the HTTP 402 payment requirements (x402 on Base, MPP on Tempo) and the URL https://rent-check-production.up.railway.app/v1/lu-asking-prices. Pay with your own x402/MPP client and retry that URL.
